restriction.android:title: Enabled sources
restriction.android:description: Which catalogue sources this store may show. Comma-separated names; blank leaves the person's own choice; 'none' disables browsing.

restriction.android:title: Show desktop sources
restriction.android:description: Whether Linux and Windows sources appear. Unset leaves the person's own choice.

restriction.android:title: Hidden packages
restriction.android:description: Package names to hide everywhere. The person cannot un-hide these from inside the app.
